title: PyEvoc: Computational Hierarchical Evocation Analysis for Digital Corpora
description: PyEvoc is an open-source Python package for computational hierarchical evocation analysis of digital corpora. The software operationalises the Hierarchical Evocation Method through reproducible workflows for corpus preprocessing, lexical unit extraction, user diffusion analysis, salience estimation, EVOC quadrant classification, semantic expansion, collocation analysis, longitudinal representational analysis, and visualisation. PyEvoc is designed for computational social science, social representation research, digital humanities, and large-scale discourse analysis.
